description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


## 中文

- 在 Windows 文件资源管理器中右键点击图片，即可贴图、标注、拼接、拆分、编辑或压缩。也可以将普通截图绑定到全局鼠标拖动手势。
- 滚动截图拼接更快，遇到重复内容时对齐更准确。处理大图、拼图和贴图时也更省内存。
- 本地文字识别按截图原始分辨率检测文字，更容易识别小字。识别窗口也更少遮挡截图工具栏。
- 修复长时间录屏时音画逐渐不同步的问题，并提高录屏裁剪导出的稳定性。
- 改善截图快捷键和鼠标手势的响应。macOS 从睡眠唤醒后，截图会重新读取显示器布局。

## English

- Right-click images in Windows File Explorer to pin, annotate, stitch, split, edit, or compress them. You can also assign a global mouse drag gesture to regular screenshots.
- Scrolling screenshots stitch faster and align repeated content more accurately. Large images, collages, and pinned images use less memory.
- Local text recognition checks screenshots at their original resolution to better pick up small text. The recognition window is also less likely to cover the screenshot toolbar.
- Fixed audio and video drifting out of sync in long screen recordings and improved the reliability of exporting trimmed recordings.
- Screenshot shortcuts and mouse gestures respond more reliably. On macOS, screen capture refreshes the display layout after waking from sleep.

## 下载指南 / Download guide

Snow Shot 是完整版，Windows 离线安装包内含文字识别组件。Snow Shot Mini 体积更小，适合截图、标注、贴图和录屏，手动识别文字时会按需下载模型。便携版解压即可运行。`-update.zip` 文件供应用内更新使用。

Snow Shot is the full edition. Its offline Windows installer includes text recognition components. Snow Shot Mini is a smaller download for screenshots, annotation, pinning, and recording. It downloads text recognition models when needed. Extract the portable ZIP to run the app. Files ending in `-update.zip` are for in-app updates.
